'''Strange Bones''' are a [[:Category:Drops|Drop]] used as a [[:Category:Drops#Materials|Material]] to craft [[Dried Tendons]], a [[:Category:Weapons' Components|Weapon Component]].

== ''Obtainment'' ==
*Dropped by all [[Primitive Parasites]].
*Dropped by all [[Adapted Parasites]].
*Dropped by [[Thrall|Thralls]].
*Can be found as loot in [[Benign Growth|Benign Growths]] and [[Malignant Growth|Malignant Growths]].
